record.title: Validate retained capture structure and terminal recorder statistics
record.intent: Make recorder statistics and captured-frame consistency independently reusable offline evidence.
requirements: Reuse the typed classic pcap decoder for structural frame inventory without requiring a TCP flow; avoid duplicate format parsers.
Parse terminal recorder counts under an explicit text-format profile with named outcomes; reject missing ambiguous contradictory and nonzero-drop evidence when assessing a complete retained capture.
Keep frame consistency, process termination, packet loss observations and on-wire completeness as distinct claims; do not infer missing counts as zero.
Test synthetic positive and negative controls and compare preserved recorder stderr and pcap locally without altering evidence.
acceptance: Independent offline capture structure and recorder-count controls pass with limits documented.
